verdict.rationale: The evidence documents scenario modeling for hypothetical future rounds, IRR and cash-on-cash calculations, and exportable scenarios. Nothing describes an exit waterfall: no proceeds per share class or stakeholder at different exit values, and no handling of liquidation preferences or participation. Round modeling and return metrics are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run exit waterfall analyses showing proceeds per share class and stakeholder under different exit values, honoring preferences and participation
